_about: Baseline content deliberately retired, each with its reason. tools/ux-ledger.js fails on anything missing that is not listed here. Exceptions cover interface labels and user-requested removal of decorative content; substantive content stays reachable.

blocks.ExplorerCompassBy backgroundBy fieldAll: Interface labels. Every destination is still linked from every page.
